question: For LAM-segment customers who use EUR, find the one with the highest total consumption in October 2013. Then, calculate their average monthly consumption in 2012 and 2013 separately, and return the difference (2012 avg monthly minus 2013 avg monthly).

prediction.sql:
WITH TopCustomer AS (
    SELECT T1."XCL_001" AS CustomerID
    FROM customers AS T1
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_019"
    WHERE T1."XCL_002" = 'LAM'
      AND T1."XCL_003" = 'EUR'
      AND T2."XCL_020" = '201310'
    GROUP BY T1."XCL_001"
    ORDER BY SUM(T2."XCL_021") DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
CustomerAverages AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN T2."XCL_020" LIKE '2012%' THEN T2."XCL_021" ELSE 0 END) / 12.0 AS AvgMonthly2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN T2."XCL_020" LIKE '2013%' THEN T2."XCL_021" ELSE 0 END) / 12.0 AS AvgMonthly2013
    FROM customers AS T1
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_019"
    INNER JOIN TopCustomer AS TC ON T1."XCL_001" = TC.CustomerID
    WHERE T2."XCL_020" LIKE '2012%' OR T2."XCL_020" LIKE '2013%'
)
SELECT 
    AvgMonthly2012 - AvgMonthly2013 AS Difference
FROM CustomerAverages

WITH customer_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.XCL_001 AS customer_id,
        t.XCL_011 AS transaction_date,
        t.XCL_018 AS consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
    WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'LAM' AND c.XCL_003 = 'EUR'
),
october_2013_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        SUM(consumption) AS total_oct_2013
    FROM customer_consumption
    WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', transaction_date) = '2013-10'
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
top_customer AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM october_2013_consumption
    ORDER BY total_oct_2013 DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
monthly_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        cc.customer_id,
        strftime('%Y', cc.transaction_date) AS year,
        strftime('%Y-%m', cc.transaction_date) AS year_month,
        SUM(cc.consumption) AS monthly_consumption
    FROM customer_consumption cc
    JOIN top_customer tc ON cc.customer_id = tc.customer_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', cc.transaction_date) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY cc.customer_id, strftime('%Y', cc.transaction_date), strftime('%Y-%m', cc.transaction_date)
),
yearly_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        year,
        AVG(monthly_consumption) AS avg_monthly
    FROM monthly_consumption
    GROUP BY customer_id, year
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT avg_monthly FROM yearly_avg WHERE year = '2012') - 
    (SELECT avg_monthly FROM yearly_avg WHERE year = '2013') AS difference
FROM top_customer
